column1: 20723§deviate§ˈdiːvieɪt§Adjustments to the direction of the tunnel also had to be made whenever builders encountered geological problems or when it deviated from its set path.§每当建筑者遇到地质问题或者隧道**偏离**既定路线时，也必须调整隧道的方向。§
20724§aquarium§əˈkweəriəm§We are going to take the kids to the new aquarium this weekend.§这周末我们打算带孩子们去新开的**水族馆**。§
20725§cell§sel§Scientists are doing cellular research, looking at changes in cells when the body is under stress.§科学家正在进行细胞研究，观察身体在压力下**细胞**内部发生的变化。§
20726§dweller§ˈdwelə(r)§An underground dweller himself, Carpenter has never paid a heating bill, thanks to solar panels and natural insulation.§作为地下**居住者**，得益于太阳能板和天然的保温条件，卡彭特从未交过取暖费。§
20727§declare§dɪˈkleə(r)§The government declared that the ballots cast were inconclusive.§政府**宣布**这次投票不具有决定性。§
20728§graduate§ˈɡrædʒuət§Nowadays, there are not many job opportunities which graduates can look forward to.§现在，本科**毕业生**所能期望的就业机会并不多。§
20729§predict§prɪˈdɪkt§The United Nations predicts that the global population may stabilise between 8 and 14 billion in the twenty-first century.§联合国**预言**，在21世纪全球人口将稳定在80亿到140亿之间。§
20730§headquarters§ˌhedˈkwɔːtəz§The daily paper is compiled at the editorial headquarters.§日报由编辑部**总部**编纂。§
20731§coverage§ˈkʌvərɪdʒ§We all wait for the live coverage of the results of the bombing trial.§我们都等着看这起爆炸审判结果的现场**报道**。§
20732§enforce§ɪnˈfɔːs§Do they enforce that rule?§他们**执行**那条规则了吗？§
20733§specialty§ˈspeʃəlti§Cross-country skiing events are a specialty of cold-weather countries.§越野滑雪赛事是气候寒冷的国家中一道**独特**的风景线。§
20734§intrinsic§ɪnˈtrɪnsɪk§Students should realize the intrinsic value of education.§学生应该认识到教育的**内在**价值。§
20735§cheat§tʃiːt§Tour operators try to cheat tourists.§旅行社的工作人员试图**欺骗**游客。§
20736§medical§ˈmedɪkl§The injured students required emergent medical attention.§那些受伤的学生急需**医疗**护理。§
20737§stick§stɪk§The pictures on the wall were simply stuck on and so could easily become detached.§墙上的画只是被简单地**固定住**，所以很容易脱落。§
20738§realistic§ˌriːəˈlɪstɪk§We must be more realistic towards the tough problem.§面对这个棘手的问题，我们应该更**现实**一点。§

20740§retailer§ˈriːteɪlə(r)§Many retailers are facing their slowest business period during the financial crisis.§在金融危机中，许多**零售商**正处在生意最低迷时期。§
20741§turnover§ˈtɜːnəʊvə(r)§The company tried its best to decrease the turnover.§公司竭尽全力降低**人事变动率**。§
20742§brand§brænd§What brand of cola do you like?§你喜欢喝什么**牌子**的可乐？§
20743§accompany§əˈkʌmpəni§Your enrolment form must be accompanied by the course deposit of $100.§你的登记表和100美元的课程押金必须**一起**上交。§
20744§mention§ˈmenʃn§He mentioned in his letter that he might be moving abroad.§他在信中**提到**他可能要移居国外。§
20745§level§ˈlevl§The noise levels at the site can reach 45 decibels.§在这种场所，噪声**水平**可达45分贝。§改译文：「值」不是 level 的意思，改为「噪声水平」
20746§lateral§ˈlætərəl§Not even our closest relatives among the apes possess such decided lateral asymmetry, as zoologists call it.§正如动物学家所认为的那样，即便是和我们有着最近的血缘关系的猿类也不具备这样明显的**侧向**不对称性。§
20747§dense§dens§The airport was closed because of the dense fog.§机场因为**浓**雾而关闭了。§改译文：「大」不是 dense 的意思，改为「浓雾」
20748§flash§flæʃ§The air can become slightly positively charged when large thunderclouds are generating the intense electrical fields that cause lightning flashes.§当大团的雷雨云产生了引发**闪电**的强烈电场时，空气会略带正电。§
20749§snack§snæk§The sandwich shop for quick snacks is nearby.§出售**快餐**的三明治店离这很近。§
20750§marvellous§ˈmɑːvələs§We'll come to a picture gallery where we've got a marvellous collection of paintings all by Australian artists.§接下来我们会来到一个画廊，这里有**绝好的**画作收藏，全都出自澳大利亚画家之手。§
20751§export§ɪkˈspɔːt§In Africa, the feathers of ostriches were used for tribal ceremonial dress and they were also exported to Europe and America.§在非洲，鸵鸟毛被用于部落的典礼服饰，同时也**出口**到欧洲和美洲。§

20753§sanitary§ˈsænətri§People living in the district suffered from appalling sanitary conditions.§住在这一区域的人们要忍受极差的**卫生**条件。§
20754§submit§səbˈmɪt§After many failures, I submitted to fate.§多次失败后，我向命运**屈服**了。§

20760§resume§rɪˈzjuːm§He resumed his reading after a nap.§小睡了一会儿后，他**继续**阅读。§
20761§primitive§ˈprɪmətɪv§Studies of primitive societies suggest that the earliest method of making fire was through friction.§对**原始**社会的研究表明，人们最早是通过摩擦生火的。§
20762§craft§krɑːft§This region is a diverse agricultural area, rich in historic sites, arts and crafts.§该地区为多种农作物种植带，且具有众多的历史遗址，艺术形式丰富，**手工艺**发达。§

20766§stake§steɪk§He was eager to return to a more entrepreneurial role in which he had a big financial stake in his own efforts.§他渴望回到更具企业家性质的角色，这样他的努力就跟自己有大的金融**利害关系**。§
20767§barge§bɑːdʒ§Beekeepers moved beehives on barges along the river to their next destination.§养蜂人用**驳船**载着蜂箱顺流而下，驶往下一个目的地。§

20769§shrub§ʃrʌb§The volunteers raked around shrubs and trees to look for the lost children.§志愿者在**灌木**丛和树林里四处寻找迷路的孩子。§
20770§slat§slæt§Try out an orthopaedic mattress or a spring slatted bed which can be beneficial for certain types of back pain.§你可以尝试使用矫形床垫或是**板条**弹簧床，这有助于缓解某些背痛。§
20771§legal§ˈliːgl§The Union has its own officers who can give advice on legal problems.§该协会拥有自己的人员，负责给**法律**事务提供建议。§
20772§cinematography§ˌsɪnəməˈtɒgrəfi§The new film provided the raw material for the introduction of cinematography a few years later.§新的电影胶片为几年后**电影摄制艺术**的诞生提供了原材料。§
20773§contribute§kənˈtrɪbjuːt§Industrial emissions and automobile exhausts contribute to heavy pollution.§工业排放物和汽车尾气共同**造成**了重度污染。§
20774§imagination§ɪˌmædʒɪˈneɪʃn§They need to train their powers of imagination.§他们需要训练自己的**想象力**。§
20775§bronchitis§brɒŋˈkaɪtɪs§Smoking can cause problems such as pneumonia, bronchitis and influenza.§吸烟能引起肺炎、**支气管炎**和流行性感冒等疾病。§
20776§exacerbate§ɪɡˈzæsəbeɪt§More intensive farming and the abandonment of fallow periods tend to exacerbate soil erosion.§更密集的耕种和取消休耕期会**加剧**土壤的侵蚀。§
20777§intrusion§ɪnˈtruːʒn§In fact, there are people who dislike any kind of perfume and think it's an intrusion.§实际上，有些人讨厌所有香水的气味，并认为别人使用香水是对自己的**侵犯**。§
20778§cancel§ˈkænsl§Could you please call the dentist at 816-25285 and cancel the appointment for me?§你能拨打816-25285帮我**取消**和牙医的预约吗？§
20779§cork§kɔːk§When a volcano erupts, the shattered summit is ejected like a cork from a shaken soda bottle.§火山喷发时，被炸碎的山峰喷射而出，就像是装有苏打水的瓶子经过摇晃，上面的**软木塞**被顶飞出去一样。§
20780§data§ˈdeɪtə§You have to spend a bit of time making the data a lot clearer.§你要花一点时间把这些**数据**整理得更清楚些。§
20781§insufficient§ˌɪnsəˈfɪʃnt§The company's funds for research were insufficient.§那家公司**没有足够**的研究资金。§
20782§grocery§ˈgrəʊsəri§I assisted in a grocery store last semester.§上学期，我在一家**杂货**店帮忙。§
20783§humid§ˈhjuːmɪd§Summers in that city are extremely hot and humid.§那个城市的夏天非常炎热**潮湿**。§改译文：「湿热」中 humid 只对应一个「湿」，改为「炎热潮湿」
20784§relation§rɪˈleɪʃn§The relation between students and teachers is generally good in this university.§这所大学里师生间的**关系**总体来说很好。§
20785§confuse§kənˈfjuːz§I'm afraid I'm a bit confused by what you said just now.§恐怕我被你刚才说的话弄得有点**糊涂**。§

20787§allocation§ˌæləˈkeɪʃn§People approved the allocation of food to those who need it most.§人们赞成把食物**分给**那些最需要的人。§
20788§entertainment§ˌentəˈteɪnmənt§The use of some entertainment can be addictive.§参与一些**娱乐**项目是会上瘾的。§改例句：addicted 指人“上瘾的”，说事物“使人上瘾”应为 addictive
20789§conquer§ˈkɒŋkə(r)§Many people have made attempts to conquer the peaks of Everest.§许多人都试图**征服**珠穆朗玛峰。§
20790§decoration§ˌdekəˈreɪʃn§The restaurant will offer decoration balloons.§餐厅会提供**装饰**气球。§
20791§reward§rɪˈwɔːd§Those employees who never take sick leave think that they should be rewarded.§那些从来不请病假的员工认为他们应该因此得到**奖励**。§
20792§larva§ˈlɑːvə§Once the beetle larvae have finished pupation, the residue is a first-rate source of fertiliser.§一旦甲虫的**幼虫**完成化蛹过程，其残留物就是最好的肥料来源。§
20793§offspring§ˈɒfsprɪŋ§With one right-handed and one left-handed parent, 15 to 20 percent of the offspring will be left-handed.§如果父母中有一个是左撇子，另一个惯用右手，那么他们的**后代**是左撇子的概率是15%到20%。§
20794§occasional§əˈkeɪʒənl§There will be occasional congruity between prophecy and fact.§预言与事实**偶尔**会一致。§
20795§crater§ˈkreɪtə(r)§After the volcano erupted, lava domes formed inside the new crater, and have periodically burst.§火山喷发后，新形成的**火山口**内部会形成熔岩穹丘，这些熔岩穹丘会周期性地爆发。§
